opennyai_summary.decision:
1. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 1070/2023 of PS Wazirabad for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
State has no objection to this petition.
It is further stated by her that towards full and final settlement of all her claims including stridhan and alimony, she has received a sum of Rs.23,50,000/- from petitioners.
Marriage between petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 already stands dissolved by decree of divorce dated 27.11.2024, and no child was born out of their wedlock.
Respondent no.2 submits that she does not wish to pursue prosecution of petitioners.
Therefore, the petition is allowed and accordingly FIR No. 1070/2023 of PS Wazirabad for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC as well as proceedings arising out of the same are quashed.
